messages:
ana: Vendor reached out — they want a key ceremony + tightly scoped retest window for the upcoming pen test. We need a clear owner for RBAC changes, audit streaming, and the KMS access plan. Who can take point?

mike: I can own RBAC changes and the Terraform bits. Need exact resource list + window.

sophie: KMS note: we don't export customer master keys. For assessors we do ephemeral grants + a wrapping key strategy. Also need CloudTrail + S3 object-lock for evidence.

ana: (typo) ana: meant to say: also need an evidence retention recommendation — vendor asked for 180 days; compliance prefers 90. tradeoffs?

mike: 90 days is our default. If vendor requires 180 we can create a separate evidence bucket with limited lifetime. Plan is timeboxed IAM role: assessor_temp_readonly with only the minimum KMS/Secrets calls.

sophie: To avoid overly broad secrets access, I'd prefer a proxy that mediates calls and logs every fetch. We already built a simple KMS‑proxy for internal audits that returns wrapped keys. Suggest reuse.

secops-bot: Incident intake created: SEC-2026-PT-42 — assigned to ana, mike. Reminder: add scope doc and evidence checklist.

ana: :thumbsup: thanks. Mike — can you sketch the role perms and a TTL policy? I'd like a dry‑run 24h before live.

mike: Will draft Terraform PR. Minimal perms glance:
```hcl
resource "aws_iam_role" "assessor_temp_readonly" {
  name = "assessor_temp_readonly_pt2026"
  assume_role_policy = <<POLICY
{...}
POLICY
  tags = { engagement = "pt-2026-03" }
}
```
And a KMS grant with constraints for encryption_context and a 48h expiry.

sophie: Also adding CloudTrail filter for KMS/Decrypt/GetPublicKey events and sending to evidence-bucket with object-lock enabled. We'll need infra to enable object-lock (immutable retention) on that bucket.

jeremy: jeremy: infra can enable object-lock but it's destructive to change on an existing bucket. We'll create a new bucket with object-lock enabled and lifecycle to 90d/180d based on the doc. Staging dry‑run ok on 2026-03-24. Live window 2026-03-25. Throttling to preserve SLOs will be applied.

ana: Good. Let's confirm owners: mike = RBAC + Terraform + role PR, sophie = KMS grants + CloudTrail filters + evidence packaging, jeremy = bucket + infra ops + staging window. I'll coordinate vendor schedule and run dry‑run.

mike: I'll open PR and tag review from sec. Expected PR link in thread once created.

sophie: I'll add playbook steps to internal doc: https://internal.redwood/security/pt-playbook (internal link) and include verification checklist for ephemeral grants.

ana: Everyone pls confirm by EOD. Dry‑run 03-24, live 03-25. @mike @sophie @jeremy confirm.

mike: confirmed.

sophie: confirmed.

secops-bot: Reminder scheduled dry-run: 2026-03-24 16:00 UTC — autoprobe will run sample evidence export.

ana: thanks — I'll update the intake ticket with the timeline and scope. If anything changes ping here.
